note: Set B captures two clearly correct claims that Set A omits entirely — the drawing scale (1 1/2" = 1'-0") and the angle member profile (L3X3X1/4) — and correctly binds segment lengths such as 3'-8 3/8" (leftmost) and 10'-3 3/4" (Module B total). Set A makes several clear misbindings: it calls 2'-3 7/8" a 'total height' when it is a horizontal segment of Detail A1, labels 1 1/2" a 'flange thickness' although the member is an L3X3X1/4 angle (1/4" thick), and twice asserts a 'base plate thickness' of 5/8" that the drawing does not support. Both sets contain vague 'dimension'/'component' claims, but Set B's main error is assigning 2'-3 7/8" to Module B/Detail A when it belongs to the Module A detail. Overall Set B is more faithful and adds the profile and scale facts Set A misses.
